label: Modal spine Arrival B: the sense of B1's beginning and its connection to the metric Grim Reaper
summary: Target: modal spine stage one, Arrival B premise B1 (8ea0321d), toward STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT (b19ffd92) and STMT-GOD-EXISTS; connect the metric Grim Reaper (attempt 5f4e157a, populatedPastsMetricallyFiniteOfPatchwork, conclusion 4365c3c5) to a root route. Spec: specs/modal-spine-metric-beginning-arrival.toml. Repaired after the independent semantic challenge (accept with repairs). SENSE FINDING. B1 as typed (PossibleCauseOfContingency.PossiblyBeginsAt) fixes no sense of beginning: the Scenario has no times and beginsContingency : World -> Prop is an uninterpreted field. The existing Arrival B theorems hold for every predicate, including the constant True used by their controls. DEF-POSSIBLE-CAUSAL-OPPORTUNITY (6343c7e8) called it a 'stipulated first obtaining' with a 'causal bearer', which the type does not enforce; its text is amended to the supplied, unconstrained predicate (BEGINS_3) and an unconstrained cause relation, and it is no longer linked from 256b5bab. Before this attempt, Arrival B concluded the Scenario statement 679eb3f7, not b19ffd92, and B1 and B2 did not reach the GOD_4 root. DISAMBIGUATION BEGINS (dc40914a). BEGINS_1 (FirstMomentBeginningAt): the time before every populated moment of the history has a first moment. BEGINS_2 (FiniteDurationBeginningAt): that time is of finite duration on the supplied clock, CLOCK_1 intended; with a bounded clock it reduces to population. BEGINS_3 (ContingencyBeginsAt): a schematic placeholder fixing no sense, now linked from 8ea0321d and df89f0d2. BEGINS_1 and BEGINS_2 constrain time, not when contingent reality began: integer time empty before 0 and populated from 0 on has contingent reality beginning a finite time ago and satisfies neither; non-negative real time empty at 0 and populated after it satisfies BEGINS_1 with no first populated moment. A fourth sense, a first populated moment after emptiness (related to A3), is named and not formalized. RESULTS (TruthCore.Causality.MetricBeginningArrival). (1) possiblyBeginsFiniteDurationOfMetricallyFinite (result 22dbb73a): metrically finite populated pasts (4365c3c5) and possible population (faa1ff28) give B1 in sense BEGINS_2 (951a2235); non-transcription. (2) possiblyFiniteDurationOfFirstMoment (8da13191): in linear time B1 in sense BEGINS_1 (b58d1aac) strengthens B1 in sense BEGINS_2 (registered strengthens relation, sense bridge BEGINS_1 to BEGINS_2); strict by control 2. (3) necessaryConcreteOfFiniteDurationBeginning (8f77abb0): Euclidean access at the selected world (1b1462e6), actual reflexivity, B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 (256b5bab) give b19ffd92; declared an instantiation of ActualEuclidean.externalNecessaryConcrete. (4) possiblyNecessaryOfFiniteDurationOpportunity (54bf1664): B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 give possibly a necessary concrete individual (d2d7cf61), with no frame premise; declared an instantiation of ExternalCandidateNecessity. (5) controls (ebf324e3): in the integer history pivot possible population holds and B1 in sense BEGINS_2 fails; in openBelow (positive reals) Euclidean access and reflexivity at true hold, B1 holds in sense BEGINS_2 and not BEGINS_1, B2 in sense BEGINS_2 fails for the empty cause relation, and no concrete individual is necessary at either world; in openBelowSource the whole bundle and the conclusion hold. Helper trivialCauseOpportunity (not a corpus result): B2 for any cause relation gives B2 for the relation that always holds, which is all the arrival uses. FRONTIER. Computed frontier-diff (root GOD_4 exists): the spaced Reaper premises 37d4e072 and bb7b476c, possible population faa1ff28 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 256b5bab now reach the root as bare leaves (276 to 280 open; 170 to 174 bare; supported 72 to 72). 4365c3c5 and 951a2235 are not open leaves: 'supported' is a source depth (a supports relation or a non-byte-verified stating claim), and intermediate conclusions of verified non-transcription arguments are expanded into their premises; they appear as the 2 added verified support alternatives. HOW MUCH IT BUYS. The Reaper reaches the root only through Arrival B, and the decisive premise there is B2. Its cause relation is an unconstrained parameter, so, given B1, its content is that possibly a BEGINS_2 history contains an existing concrete individual outside the contingent totality, which by ExternalCandidateNecessity is a necessary concrete individual of that history: close to stipulating the possibility of the target. A rival who denies that possibility rejects B2 outright; the arrival does not discriminate against that rival. B1 in sense BEGINS_2 is the cheap premise: given the Reaper conclusion every accessible populated history is a BEGINS_2 history (analyst observation from the definitions, not registered), and under L (solutions of accepted laws are possible), the principle of the FLRW objection to begun pasts, a possible populated FLRW history gives it without any Reaper premise (not formalized). The Reaper's contribution is interpretive: it makes the possible populated histories BEGINS_2 histories, in which a causal-opportunity principle for beginnings would apply if one were granted for BEGINS_2 histories; no warrant for such a principle is on file. Arrival A still cannot use the metric conclusion. OBJECTION AND WARRANT AUDIT (Substantive Objection Standard). B1 in sense BEGINS_2: no substantive objection identified (no recorded argument that in every possible populated history the time before some populated moment is metrically infinite); the open Misner-type objection targets the CLOCK_1 choice; the Reaper route inherits the undercutting objection to spaced patchwork (5f4e157a). Possible population: no substantive objection identified. B2 in sense BEGINS_2: no positive warrant on file. The reviewed 2026-11-11 audit of the parameter-sense premise (docs/notes/causal-temporal-rival-coverage.md, 'Positive modal causal opportunity'; attempt 169b007b) applies unchanged: (a) the causal marker and the beginning predicate do no work in ExternalCandidateNecessity, and here the cause relation is an unconstrained parameter; (b) source-availability defeater against B2's warrant: causal uniformity from ordinary caused beginnings preserves the effect's intrinsic character but not a producer once every contingent producer is removed from the prehistory, and a necessary producer is admissible only if the disputed population question is settled; (c) contingent-natural restriction rival, motivated by the difference between producing within an inventory and producing the first inventory, at the price of an explanatory stop or an unspecified intrinsic account of the initial inventory. (d) First-instant objection (Grünbaum-type, analyst formulation, not read from a source): an open-below finite past has no instant at which contingent reality comes to be, so a uniformity argument from ordinary beginnings (coming to be at an instant after an earlier state) has no matching instance among open-below BEGINS_2 histories; it targets B2's warrant, not the typed premise, whose cause relation carries no temporal constraint. The brute-beginning rival survives as a model (control 2), which shows B2 is needed, not that it is false. Nothing is attributed to any author. No premise is established. CAUSAL REINTERPRETATION 2026-11-22 (proposed, review/CI pending). Reused the shared CausalityFrame.GivesAt primitive to define ConcurrentTotalityGivingAt: an actual giving of being to every contingent concrete at every populated moment plus at least one exercised giving, rather than an unconstrained W->B cause label. ConcurrentFiniteDurationCausalOpportunity instantiates existing B2 with this strong memberwise reading (not identical to holistic totality causation). Conditional possiblyNecessaryConcurrentGiver and necessaryActualWithPossibleConcurrentGiving derive a rigid necessary concrete bearer and retain its actual causal exercise in the accessible witness history; necessaryConcreteOfConcurrentGiving recovers the original necessary-concrete endpoint. The original inference's necessity still relies on the OPEN external-candidate possibility, not the causal conjunct. Controls inertGivingSeparatesOpportunity, functioningConcurrentOpportunity and mixedPossibleGivingWithoutActualGiving show respectively original B2 need not include any giving; a strong-B2 model is coherent; and possible actual giving by the source need not occur in the designated actual world despite its contingent population. No God-existence premise is closed, no new graph edge registered. See the new section of docs/notes/modal-spine.md. 2026-11-22 RESEARCH GRAPH CONTINUATION (supersedes the earlier "no new graph edge" sentence in this historical summary; review pending). A distinct enriched possible-world source statement 34b957cd now records the SAME rigid necessary concrete bearer at actual w and actual concurrent memberwise GivesAt exercise in an accessible history v (not necessarily at w). Its proof result 8b9693f6 consumes BEGINS_2 B1 951a2235, stronger B2 e4a3b917 and actual Euclidean/reflexive frame premises. Result e43f423e projects that SAME bearer to the original necessary concrete conclusion b19ffd92, labelled logical instantiation. More consequentially, new non-transcription result 9e5124a2 derives strong B2 e4a3b917 from a strictly weaker nonexternal possible universal giver 2a4d99d8, no actual strict self-esse-giving 0e473dc4 and temporal occurrence of contingent concrete individuals d3184c66: if an existing source were contingent it would be a temporally present effect and its universal causal act would have to cause its own being. Contradiction derives noncontingency and exteriority from the universal scope of the giving clause over a possibly contingent source; exteriority is not stated in the nonexternal premise. REPAIR AFTER THE INDEPENDENT SEMANTIC CHALLENGE ON #1856: the commitment to a possibly necessary concretum is relocated into that universal clause, not removed. The converse holds by dropping the exteriority conjunct (nonexternalOpportunityOfExternal), so under 0e473dc4 and d3184c66 the nonexternal premise 2a4d99d8 and strong B2 e4a3b917 are equivalent (nonexternalIffExternalOpportunity, comparator companion of 9e5124a2). A rival who denies that a necessary concretum is possible, while keeping no-self-giving and temporal presence, rejects 2a4d99d8 exactly as e4a3b917; the route makes that rival's cost explicit (no concrete thing could give being to every contingent concretum of a possible BEGINS_2 history) but does not discriminate against it. The temporal-presence premise d3184c66 excludes contingent atemporal concreta (it does not merely leave them out of scope); only necessary concreta may be timeless. GivesAt is read strictly (definition 158301bc); the universal clause is CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 over the frame restricted to temporally present contingent concreta (concurrentTotalityGiving_iff_sustains, disambiguation 88a8fba7). Two finite structural controls separately omit no-self-giving and temporal occurrence, not metaphysical objections. Computed CI frontier diff on head 0fc8522: 2 additional non-transcription support alternatives to the root, 3 new OPEN leaf candidates, no establishment or discharge; the projected instantiation is not a new non-transcription option. The positive conditional route no longer mentions modality or exteriority in its causal premise, but given the two principles it carries the same modal commitment; it still asks for a possible memberwise complete causal producer, a stronger claim than holistic totality causation. Actual-world causal exercise, physical temporal origin, and unique/divine attributes remain open. Child PR #1863 offers horizontal Second Way support for 0e473dc4 through an OPEN history- and moment-indexed self-edge bridge and all-histories, all-moments analyst versions of the no-self-cause and cause-priority premises (attempt 33fd084a), not through the selected-time Aquinas statements themselves. Independent semantic review remains pending; avoid claim of actual God-source activity. Reopen on nonexternal cause availability and the memberwise/holistic mapping, stronger actual-world activity warrant, and precise causal bridge justification.
blocker: 2026-11-22 proposed answer: the original B2 relation may be instantiated with genuinely actual concurrent memberwise GivesAt, and the necessary-concrete route remains conditionally valid with the stronger causal conclusion in its possible witness history. Still OPEN: why an externally necessary concrete causal producer of the contingent inventory is metaphysically available in a possible BEGINS_2 history; the externality clause already encodes the possibility of de re necessity. The nonexternal route 2a4d99d8 + 0e473dc4 + d3184c66 -> e4a3b917 (result 9e5124a2) does not remove this blocker: under no-self-giving and temporal presence the nonexternal premise is equivalent to e4a3b917 (nonexternalIffExternalOpportunity), so the same commitment sits in its universal giving clause. What remains to be supplied is positive warrant that a single concrete thing could give being to every contingent concretum of a possible BEGINS_2 history, without presupposing that a necessary concretum is possible; the non-discrimination against a rival who denies that possibility stands. Memberwise causation is stronger than a cause of the collective totality, so the weaker holistic reading and its interpretive bridge remain open. Even strong B2 does not entail actual-world giving of being without another premise. Independent semantic review and Lean/CI validation pending; no source attribution or frontier closure.
